summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (41 passed) using the shared venv Python. Nothing was committed. Caveats: mypy, black, and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so type-check and formatting were verified by reading the code and checking line lengths (all within 88 columns), not by running the tools.
